features:
🌾 Auto Farm Resources – Automatically gather nearby resources for continuous progress.
🧭 Auto Expand Land – Auto-purchase land expansions when available to grow your base.
⚒️ Auto Crafter – Automatically craft items when materials are ready.
⛏️ Auto Gold Mine – Runs the gold mine automatically (requires Coal Crate to operate).
🪙 Auto Collect Gold (from Mines) – Collect gold from mines as soon as it’s available.
🛒 Auto Sell – Automatically sell collected items for instant cash.
🌱 Auto Harvest Plants – Harvest crops and plants continuously without manual input.
🐝 Auto Collect Hive – Automatically collect from hives and pet sources.
🛍️ (Auto) Buy Items – Purchase selected items or upgrades automatically.
⏱️ New Items Timer – Notify or auto-purchase when new items become available.
🛡️ Anti-AFK – Prevents idle kicks so your automation can run safely while away.
